checks: The State Revenue Committee describes up to ten types of medicines with up to three retail packs of each for personal use or treatment without certification. A physician-supported treatment need may justify a larger quantity.
Armenia inbound baggage, ordinary medicines, both registered and unregistered
Read the separate rules for internationally controlled products. The Committee states the generally applicable allowance, and product-specific controls still apply.

The Committee states that covered narcotic and psychotropic medicines must be registered in Armenia. Customs requires supporting documentation proving need and identifying the medicine and quantity, plus any required notarized Armenian translation. In this pathway no separate import licence is required and the product is declared.
Armenia inbound personal use of controlled medicines, separate from the ordinary allowance
Check registration and scheduling for the actual product. Consult the cited Armenian legal instruments for exceptional cases.
Azerbaijan Customs identifies medicines in quantities needed for personal use as not subject to customs duties under its preferential passenger procedures.
Azerbaijan, fiscal relief for a necessary personal quantity; separate from ingredient-specific authorizations
Verify the controlled-substance entitlement, documentary evidence, and what the customs officer accepts as personal quantity.
The March 2024 government submission lists a valid prescription and distinguishes covered narcotic and psychotropic medicines under its carriage regulations.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border
Do not infer duty-free treatment overrides controlled medicine rules; consult current domestic regulation for precise quantities and permit conditions.
The Bahamas Embassy recommends a physician letter stating the prescription is medically needed, for presentation to Customs if questioned.
Bahamas visitor advisory for medicine already prescribed for an existing condition
Embassy of The Bahamas to the United States
The letter is an embassy recommendation. Confirm restricted ingredients, statutory permit routes and ordinary quantity limits.
The Bahrain form dated 26 February 2024 reports a seven-day limit for covered narcotic and psychotropic medicines and lists medical or health authority documentation.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border

The directory URL suggests 2025, but the page shows 2024. Verify the current method to obtain the destination certificate, any exceptional amounts and the separate guided route for ordinary accompanied medicines.
Belarus reports distinct caps for covered narcotic and psychotropic medicines and a requirement for medical records or certified copies with a certified Belarusian or Russian translation when needed.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border

Verify current limits, exceptions, permitted medicines list and the separate ordinary pharmaceutical route. The form gives a narcotic cap of seven days and expresses the psychotropic cap per dose, not per day.

Bhutan FDA guidance exempts personal medically prescribed products carried with a valid prescription from registration. It also describes a registration exception for listed nonprescription personal medicines totaling less than a one-month dose.
Registration is a different concept from carriage authorization. For controlled medicines see the specific controlled-substance process.
Bhutan reports that allowances for covered controlled medicine follow the prescription and identifies prescription and health authority paperwork in the 2025 traveler submission.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border
Confirm the operative 2024 regulation to distinguish cumulative versus alternative documents and where approval or a declaration is required.

The Bosnia and Herzegovina customs authority allows ordinary personal medicines in a quantity appropriate to standard treatment with supporting medical records. It states a seven-day maximum for covered psychotropic substances, with specified addiction-substitution and terminal-cancer-treatment exceptions extending it to 15 days. It instructs travelers to declare the controlled medication and quantity and show the medical documents.
Bosnia and Herzegovina passenger border movements; documented routine therapy and specially controlled medicines
Indirect Taxation Authority of Bosnia and Herzegovina

Current customs guidance distinguishes the seven-day default from the 15-day exception. The INCB form compresses this into a range, so use the domestic guidance and enforcement notice for proper applicability.

ANVISA treats medicines as personal baggage when the amount is reasonable relative to the stay and treatment and does not suggest a commercial purpose. It explains health oversight for accompanied baggage.
Brazil, inbound personal medicines in accompanied baggage
The 2016 English INCB file produced no usable text. Verify controlled prescription and cannabis-derived product exceptions separately.
Brunei pharmaceutical services guidance describes an import-licence exception for personal-use medicines in a traveller’s luggage up to one month’s use by one person.
Brunei ordinary import-licensing exception for accompanied baggage
Brunei Ministry of Health Department of Pharmaceutical Services
The currently hosted guidance dates from 2017. Verify application under controlled drugs rules and any later amendments. Do not use the 2016 submission alone to infer controlled allowances.

Chile’s Public Health Institute baggage guide describes prescription or clinician certificate documentation and treatment-consistent quantities for prescribed medicine, personal-need quantities for OTC products, original packaging, and restrictions on pharmaceutical raw materials.
Chile, ordinary and prescribed passenger baggage including the customs concept of personal effects
Instituto de Salud Pública de Chile

The institute prefers translation into Spanish when needed. The baggage guide distinguishes use by the traveller or direct family for the relevant prescribed products, with OTC limited to the traveller.

Chile’s July 2025 Public Health Institute submission ties allowed narcotic or psychotropic medicine quantity to the documented dose and duration, and accepts a qualifying treatment certificate instead of the prescription.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border
Instituto de Salud Pública de Chile
Distinguish accompanied personal baggage from controlled pharmaceutical shipments. A blank general day-count field is not unlimited allowance.
The NMPA submission marks a valid prescription for the covered personal carriage of controlled medicines but leaves the day and quantity boxes empty.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border
National Medical Products Administration of China
Do not infer unrestricted quantities or import permission from blank fields. Corroborate with current Mainland customs rules and any 2026 implementation changes.

Article 54 of Resolution 4651/2005 covers defined narcotic and psychotropic schedules and describes a standard 30-day maximum for accompanied personal use and a prescription copy when entering Colombia.
Colombia, scheduled medicines and defined passenger treatment scope
Colombia Ministry of Social Protection via INVIMA
Cross-check consolidation and the ordinary passenger medicines rules. Do not transfer the 30-day limit to unrelated medicines.

Costa Rica’s published Drugs Surveillance Board guidance gives a one-month treatment quantity for covered personal narcotic or psychotropic preparations, with identity and clinical or purchase documentation as applicable.
Costa Rica personal controlled medicines; distinguishes inbound and outbound documentation
Costa Rica Ministry of Health Drugs Surveillance Board
The traveler guidance dates to 2013. Check current inbound authorization practice and ordinary-medicine entry. The 2021 circular addresses patients leaving Costa Rica.
Cyprus Pharmaceutical Services lists issuance of permits for visitors who possess medicines containing controlled substances for personal treatment.
Republic of Cyprus controlled medicines, visitor permit
Cyprus Ministry of Health Pharmaceutical Services
Consult route-specific requirements. Do not extrapolate across differently administered territories or to general medicines.

The Ivorian pharmaceutical regulator offers a special personal-use import authorization route for individuals or unaccredited organizations. Its newer INCB submission gives a controlled-medicine reference point.
Côte d’Ivoire pharmaceutical import authority; personal import procedure, with exact accompanied baggage applicability unresolved
Check whether or how this authorization applies to accompanied baggage and verify both ordinary and controlled quantities for travellers.
El Salvador’s 2025 government submission distinguishes qualifying controlled personal prescriptions and authorization handling, including what to do when prior authorization was not obtained.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border
El Salvador competent medicines authority as listed in its INCB report
Verify current application instructions, transit, ingredient-specific treatment and separate ordinary passenger baggage.

The Ethiopian regulator’s personal-use port clearance guidance specifies official request and identity documentation, ordinary over-the-counter and prescription categories, a standard 90-day quantity, and prior authorization for certain larger amounts. Prescription items require a valid clinician prescription.
Ethiopia, personal medicines examined at port clearance
The controlled-category prescription and acceptable-document requirements must be read with the specific 2025 directive. The permit exception does not eliminate documentation.

The controlled-medicine directive specifies an individual application and authenticated medical documentation for personal import. It states covered patients may use a prescription pathway without a special import permit and sets a traveller maximum of three months for the covered narcotic or psychotropic medicines.
Ethiopia, arriving patients and personally carried covered controlled medicine
Verify the exact permissible list, application procedure and product-specific exclusions from the regulator for the individual medicine.

Georgia’s consular authority describes a 31-day maximum for covered purchased-abroad personal treatment medicines containing controlled substances, excluding substances whose circulation is prohibited, plus declaration and relevant documented proof.
Georgia, controlled-substance allowance and exceptions for personal medication brought from abroad
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Georgia
Verify separate ordinary medication quantities and whether current Georgian Revenue Service procedures modify required documents.
Ghana FDA’s published import guideline identifies prescription products for personal use in its special-approval discussion for imports outside ordinary registered products.
Ghana pharmaceutical import and clearance framework, with personal traveler baggage applicability unresolved
The guideline discusses consignee and product approval. Verify accompanied baggage treatment, quantity and controlled product exceptions before using it as traveler instruction.
Hong Kong’s Drug Office describes a possible licensing exemption for pharmaceutical products carried by the arriving passenger in a reasonable quantity for that person’s use.
Hong Kong SAR, accompanied baggage and ordinary pharmaceutical licensing
Hong Kong Department of Health Drug Office
Read controlled and dangerous drugs restrictions separately and verify exact current licensing and declaration. The Drug Office publication is older.
Hong Kong SAR’s August 2024 submission marks a valid prescription for the covered medicines but provides no standalone controlled quantity in the blank limit fields.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border
Hong Kong Security Bureau Narcotics Division
Blank fields cannot support unrestricted import. Confirm controls on named products and special licence requirements with Hong Kong authorities.

Ireland’s Department of Health March 2025 submission describes a 30-day quantity for covered controlled prescriptions and an Article 75 certificate for Schengen residents arriving from within the Schengen area with covered Schedule II or III medicines.
Ireland, controlled prescriptions with Schengen-resident route condition affecting certain schedules
Ireland Department of Health via INCB
Check the department’s linked implementing guidance and ordinary or other-route medication rules. Do not generalize the certificate requirement to every visitor.

Israel’s Ministry of Health explains an ordinary traveler allowance up to a 90-day supply, with narcotic and psychotropic substances excluded from that shortcut even if their origin classification differs.
Israel inbound travellers with ordinary personal medicine
The June 2026 INCB controlled-product submission must be read separately. Confirm prohibited products and certificate acceptance before closing.
The Israel Ministry of Health’s June 2026 form identifies a 31-day cap for covered narcotic and psychotropic medicines, original dispensed containers and an authority-endorsed carrying certificate.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border
Israel Ministry of Health Pharmaceutical Division
Confirm precise inbound versus outbound certificate presentation and prohibitions in the current traveler guidance, particularly if traveling with a medicine outside general categories.

Kenya’s Pharmacy and Poisons Board identifies certain personal-use medicines as regulated healthcare imports and directs import authorization inquiries to its office. Its 2024 government submission separately discusses documented controlled-medicine carriage.
Kenya passenger entry; authorization authority and traveler-controlled evidence, differentiated from commercial mail or freight
Check the extent of personal baggage exceptions and current controlled limits directly rather than assume all accompanied medicines require an import permit.

Kuwait’s March 2024 form describes separate treatment for narcotics and permitted listed psychotropic medicines. It gives a 30-day reference for the permitted psychotropic category and marks a valid medical prescription and original prescription at customs.
Destination government submission to INCB for personal carriage of covered medicines across its border
Kuwait Ministry of Health Drug and Food Control Sector
Confirm the current operative lists and ordinary personal medicine treatment. Do not infer that a valid prescription overrides a prohibited substance classification.
